content: {DRAFT} Service Name EthTrcv_MacSecUpdateRxSa (DRAFT) Syntax Std_ReturnType EthTrcv_MacSecUpdateRxSa ( uint8 TrcvIdx, uint8 An, uint64 LowestPn, boolean Active ) Service ID [hex] 0x20 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different TrcvIdx, Non reentrant for the same TrcvIdx TrcvIdx Index of the Ethernet transceiver within the context of the Ethernet Transceiver Driver An Association Number to use in the MACsec's reception secure association LowestPn Lowest accepted Packet Number in the MACsec's reception secure association Parameters (in) Active Boolean to enable/disable the MACsec's reception secure association Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: The request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: The request has not been accepted Description Request the Ethernet Transceiver Driver to update the Reception Secure Association with the given Packet Number. The Active parameter is included to change the specified AN status. Tags: atp.Status=DRAFT Available via EthTrcv.h
